list.emptyDescription: A node is a machine running wsmp. Add one with a one-line install command; it shows up here when it connects.

add.title: Add a node
add.description: Run one command on the machine. The code in it is your approval: nodes that use it join your account without another click.
add.replaceDescription: Run this on the new machine (or after reinstalling). It takes over this node's runtimes, labels and settings, and the old login stops working.
add.labelsHint: Optional. Lower-case words separated by spaces, used to pick nodes for runtimes.
add.labelsInvalid: Use up to 32 lower-case labels (letters, digits, dashes).
add.temporaryHint: Remove each node (and release everything on it) after it has been offline this long.
add.failed: The command could not be created.
add.secretOnce: This code is shown only once.
add.waiting: Waiting for the node to connect…
add.joinedDeleted: A node joined and was removed since

codes.title: Install codes
codes.description: Codes you created to add nodes, and who used them.

fabrics.title: Fabrics
fabrics.description: Fast links between nodes (for example a cabled pair or a switch). A runtime that spans several nodes runs inside one fabric.
fabrics.help: Give each node's address on the fast link. Nodes find the network interface from that address; nothing else is configured.
fabrics.empty: No fabrics yet. Add one from a node's page.
fabrics.renameDescription: Runtime definitions that name the old name stop matching it.
fabrics.name: Fabric name
fabrics.nameInvalid: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.
fabrics.deleteDescription: Removes the fabric and every node's address on it. Refused while a runtime runs across it.
fabrics.typeName: Type the fabric name to confirm
fabrics.nodeDescription: This node's address on each fast link. A new name creates the fabric.
fabrics.membershipInvalid: Each fabric needs a name and this node's IP address (not 0.0.0.0 or loopback), once per fabric.

detail.loadFailed: This node could not be loaded.
detail.notFound: This node does not exist or is not yours.
detail.renameDescription: The display name. Leave it empty to show the node's slug.
detail.name: Name
detail.deleteDescription: Its always-on runtimes go, everything reserved on it is released and runtimes with a part on it stop. The machine itself is not changed.
detail.typeSlug: Type the node's slug to confirm

trustCard.title: Trust
trustCard.fullDescription: The server may run commands, edit files, open terminals and change definitions on this node (people, and agents with Full access).
trustCard.relayDescription: The server only relays requests to what this node already holds. People can still start and stop those definitions; nothing else changes remotely.
trustCard.lowerDescription: This sticks on the node. Only running `wsmp trust full` on the machine raises it again.
trustCard.nothingFrozen: No definitions or metric commands on this node.
trustCard.secrets: Secrets, then set only on the node
trustCard.stopsList: Commands, files, browser terminals, definition changes, and agent starts and stops.
trustCard.sticky: Lowering protects against future problems only: what already runs keeps running.
trustCard.lowered: Lowering requested. The node confirms when it is online.
trustCard.raiseHint: To give the server full control again, run this on the machine:

hold.title: Hold
hold.description: While held, nothing new is placed on this node, for anyone. What runs keeps running.

temporary.title: Temporary node
temporary.description: Remove this node (releasing everything on it) after it has been offline this long.

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.description: What placement counts on. Each value shows where it comes from.

definition.frozen: This node is Relay only, so its settings are frozen.
definition.saved: Saved. The node gets the change when it is online.
definition.placementDescription: Labels and ports runtimes use on this node.
definition.portsInvalid: Ports 1024 to 65535, first not after last.
definition.commandMaxHelp: Commands run on this node are stopped after this long at most.
definition.metricCommandsDescription: Commands the node runs on a schedule to report extra metrics.
definition.metricCommandsInvalid: Not a valid list of metric commands ({{detail}}).

secrets.description: Values commands and runtimes on this node can use by name. They go straight to the node and are never shown again.
